usedFor: Mailparser holds parsed emails and Loyverse holds your products, so “New Email Parsed” can run “Create Or Update Variant”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Create Or Update Variant” in Loyverse
bestTemplate.why: A parsed email updates a product variant, so details sent by email reach your till without retyping.

watchOut: “New Parsed Email (one request per row)” runs once per row, so a long table makes many variant calls.
